intro_say: Trump's day, in five quotes. Let's go!
outro_say: Love it or hate it, every speech and post from today is linked in the caption. Follow for tomorrow's five!

quotes.quote: If Republicans win the House of Representatives and the Senate, I am going to give all adult citizens in the United States $5,000.
quotes.quote_say: If Republicans win the House of Representatives and the Senate, I am going to give all adult citizens in the United States five thousand dollars.
quotes.intro_say: On a five thousand dollar check.

quotes.quote: Isn't it nice to have a president who doesn't need a teleprompter?
quotes.intro_say: On a windy rally where his teleprompters blew away.

quotes.quote: I passed it all three times. I aced it. Zero mistakes all three times.
quotes.said_before_note: He has talked about acing the test for years

quotes.quote: Oh, Canada has been ripping us off for many, many years.
You know, I owned the Miss Universe contest long ago.
quotes.intro_say: And, out of nowhere, on Miss Universe.
